info.title: GitHub repository facts
info.description:
Three facts nothing else in this realm can supply: whether a repository is ARCHIVED (formally retired while its package still installs), when its default branch last actually moved, and whether the repository a package claims even resolves.

RATE LIMITED. 60 requests an hour unauthenticated, 5,000 with a token. One call per repository, cached for a day.

get.summary: Repository metadata, including archived and the last push
The default branch's most recent commit
get.description: `per_page=1` makes this one row: the head of the default branch. Its committer date is what people mean by 'is this still being worked on' — NOT the repository's `pushed_at`, which any branch or tag push bumps. Measured on `request/request` the two are four and a half years apart.
